coord_source.description: citation for the coordinates (paper, NASA page, etc.)

description.description: one or two sentences for the public/educator view

elevation_m.description: OPTIONAL: terrain height relative to the 1737.4 km sphere (LOLA)

is_region.description: OPTIONAL: true if the site is a region (e.g. Artemis III candidate) given by a centre point

mission_date.description: OPTIONAL: landing date (YYYY-MM-DD) of a past or planned mission

coord_source_url.description: OPTIONAL: link to the page that gives the coordinates

coord_kind.description: OPTIONAL: what the point marks: landed position, impact point of a failed landing, a published target point, or the centre of a named target region

coord_accuracy_m.description: OPTIONAL: horizontal accuracy stated by the source, m

agency.description: OPTIONAL: agency or company that flew the mission

country.description: OPTIONAL: country of the agency or company

slope_baseline_m.description: OPTIONAL: pixel size the slope was measured over (80, 240 or 237 m)
